address: The Abu Dhabi EDITION Hotel, Al Bateen Marina, Abu Dhabi
bio: Dressed like a smart London club, all wood and leather – but with the music turned up loud – Oak Room is all about meat. Steaks, largely from Japan and Australia, come in various cuts and are accompanied by an impressive selection of sides; don’t miss the triple cooked chips. Sunday roasts are popular and there’s a wide variety of other dishes on offer too, from fish and chips to burgers.
